prompts.starfield: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production background texture for Mission Cosmos, a friendly astronomy educational mobile 3D game. A complete 360-degree celestial environment as a FLAT EQUIRECTANGULAR LATITUDE-LONGITUDE panorama, exact 2:1 aspect ratio, ideally 2048x1024 or larger native 2:1. Subject: a calm deep midnight-navy outer-space starfield. Background nearly black #070B16 with subtle #0B1220 variation, sparse to moderate tiny pinprick white and pale blue stars scattered organically, a handful slightly warmer faint stars. Vast dark breathing space to keep interactive 3D planets readable in front. Star distribution extends evenly across the entire map, with no central composition or vanishing point. At most a barely perceptible distant blue-gray dust haze. Restrained contrast, elegant natural educational-game look consistent with navy/turquoise/gold Mission Cosmos identity. Stars should mostly be very small fine points, not bokeh, not glowing blobs and no large stylized star crosses. NO planets, NO moon, NO sun, NO spacecraft, NO horizon, NO buildings, NO text, NO constellation lines, NO UI, NO borders. Seamless wrap left-to-right with matching edge color and star density; latitude-correct polar stretching and quiet pole regions for spherical mapping. Uniform environment, no baked directional sun, no lens flare, no vignette. This is an artistic starfield, not an accurate astronomical star catalog. Opaque full-frame texture, no transparency. Deliver only the panorama image, no mockup and no globe.
prompts.nebula: Create ONE production game sky background for Mission Cosmos astronomy learning app. Flat full-frame 2:1 EQUIRECTANGULAR 360-degree celestial panorama, ideally native 2048x1024. Deep midnight navy #070B16 space, delicate thin wisps of distant blue-turquoise #3DB8C5 and restrained muted violet nebula dust extending organically across the panorama, scattered tiny white/pale blue stars. Beautiful but understated, very dark and uncluttered in broad areas so foreground 3D planets and educational UI remain legible. Atmospheric spaciousness, no central bright hotspot, no glowing sun. Soft natural-looking gas clouds, fine structure, subdued saturation, no thick opaque cloud walls, no neon rainbow. Artistic polished astronomy game visual matching a navy/turquoise/gold identity. Seamless left/right longitude boundary: carry wisps across edges coherently at similar brightness, quiet near-black top/bottom pole regions, slight polar stretching for inside-sphere projection. No planets, no moons, no spheres, no spacecraft, no horizon, no terrain, no text, no borders, no constellation outlines, no artificial lens flares. Opaque RGB image covering the full frame, no transparency. A fictional scenic environment, NOT a scientific sky chart. Only the map, no presentation.
prompts.milky-way: Create ONE opaque RGB production space background for Mission Cosmos astronomy mobile learning game. Deliver ONLY a flat full-frame EQUIRECTANGULAR latitude-longitude 360-degree sky map in a precise 2:1 ratio, ideally 2048x1024. Artistic view INSIDE the Milky Way: a broad but restrained luminous band of countless distant fine stars and subtle dusty dark lanes stretches continuously across the middle latitudes of the panorama, gently undulating, joining at the left and right edges at the same latitude and brightness. Delicate pearl-white, muted dusty gold and cool blue tones against deep midnight navy #070B16, wide dark quiet areas toward both poles. A beautiful expansive familiar Milky Way night sky, viewed from space with no horizon; NOT an exterior spiral galaxy floating in front of the camera. Keep luminosity moderate so 3D planets remain visually dominant. Fine pinpoint stars, natural irregularities, softly resolved galactic dust. Style polished and realistic yet calm and readable for an educational family app. No foreground planet, no Sun, no moon, no spacecraft, no buildings, no terrain, no constellation annotations, no words, no framing, no lens flare, no giant stars. Equirectangular pole-aware mapping and seamless horizontal wrap are essential. This is an evocative artistic background, not an accurate star map, not a scientific coordinate chart. No transparency.
